name: AI Strategy & Enablement
summary: Move from AI interest to an informed decision about where it can help, what it needs and how to begin.
buyerProblem: A promising demonstration is not yet a business case. We connect potential AI use cases to available data, operational constraints and a clear way to evaluate whether the solution is useful.
deliverables: Prioritized use cases and data requirements
Evaluation criteria, risks and human review points
A pilot plan and an enablement approach
process: Explore decisions, tasks and information flows.
Compare AI options against simpler alternatives.
Define a pilot, evaluation process and adoption plan.

faqs.question: What if our data is not ready?
faqs.answer: That is a useful starting point. We identify the data and process work needed before an AI pilot can be evaluated responsibly.

faqs.question: Will you recommend AI for every problem?
faqs.answer: No. Rules, better integration or a simpler workflow may be more appropriate. The recommendation follows the problem.
